verdict.rationale: The only dbt-related evidence is one community remark that BigQuery's pipe syntax is 'great for dbt macros', which implies dbt is used against BigQuery but does not document an adapter. The vendor docs instead feature Dataform, Google's own transformation service, and contain no dbt adapter or native dbt project support. Missing for 10: vendor-documented dbt adapter, native dbt project support in BigQuery, first-party dbt setup/configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration of dbt workflows.
